source.name: Department of Disaster Management (DDM) AWARE Shelter Information
source.name_bn: দুর্যোগ ব্যবস্থাপনা অধিদপ্তরের AWARE আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রের তথ্য
source.agency: Department of Disaster Management (DDM), Ministry of Disaster Management and Relief

structureReview.method: Parse the shelter JSON array embedded in the source page; count finite non-origin coordinate pairs and points inside the population-grid extent. Do not execute scripts or import records.
limitations: Source structure and coordinate presence reviewed; individual location accuracy and source update date are unknown.
Within-extent count is not DNCC/DSCC coverage, unique buildings or operational shelter availability.
Source-reported capacity, status and accessibility fields are not independently verified readiness.
No separate API or reuse licence established by this page inspection.
No source records, coordinates or personal contacts are included in this aggregate review.
Source page has a table and embedded structured JSON; no separate API established by this review.
Embedded JSON contains lat/lon; individual positions and current shelter availability remain unreviewed.
National inventory — Dhaka North/South coverage not yet established.
covering_people is source-reported, not verified available capacity.
Personal contact details must not be republished in the public interface.
Reuse terms pending review — treat as publicly accessible, not open data.

studyBoundary.name: Dhaka population-grid study extent
studyBoundary.derivation: Atlas bbox [90.25,23.60,90.55,23.95] expanded to whole 1 km UTM46N cells; outer corners exported to WGS84.
limitations: Population-grid study extent only; no DNCC/DSCC boundary match has been established.
Does not represent legal jurisdiction or evacuation zones.
Facility reference is clipped to this grid; legacy river references can lie outside it.
Study boundary must be reviewed against official DNCC/DSCC limits before planning use.

scenarioTypes.label: Shelter inventory review
scenarioTypes.note: DDM national shelter inventory; Dhaka records unreviewed.
scenarioTypes.note_bn: DDM জাতীয় আশ্রয় তালিকা; ঢাকা রেকর্ড পর্যালোচনাধীন।

note: The DDM page embeds structured coordinates. Source-structure counts do not establish individual location accuracy, municipal coverage or operational readiness. No records are imported and no shelter pins are published pending location and publication review.
note_bn: DDM পাতায় কাঠামোবদ্ধ স্থানাঙ্ক রয়েছে। উৎসের রেকর্ডের সংখ্যা দিয়ে প্রতিটি অবস্থানের নির্ভুলতা, পৌর এলাকার আওতা বা কার্যকর প্রস্তুতি প্রতিষ্ঠিত হয় না। অবস্থান ও প্রকাশের পর্যালোচনা না হওয়া পর্যন্ত কোনো রেকর্ড আমদানি বা আশ্রয়কেন্দ্রের চিহ্ন প্রকাশ করা হয়নি।
